additional_info.subject: RE: ID0400855-DC/Si-D/SG-[MP / R4 170001684] Charger are going out of order with IMD Modbus communication error CRM:00641000965
additional_info.body:
Dear Edna,
I hope all is well with you. I'm Sambath, and I'll be supporting you on this case from expert team. I have examined the logs for the past one month and found that Outlet 1 is randomly going out of order with IMD modbus communication interruptions, as we mentioned last week. Modbus communication interruptions vary in duration, but they always result in the outlet becoming inaccessible. Please schedule a site intervention so that IMD BC1 configuration and wiring can be checked. Please schedule the IMD replacement if everything is in order so that we can keep an eye on the charger's performance following the replacement.
If you have any questions or need any assistance throughout the intervention, please feel free to get in touch with me.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sambath.K.S
